reviews.text:
I’m so happy with Animal Crackers! They did AMAZING with my baby Onz. She came out looking absolutely adorable, fluffy, clean, and perfectly groomed. 🥹🐶

But honestly, what made me happiest was how well they took care of her. I’m always a little nervous leaving her somewhere, and I felt so comfortable knowing she was in good hands. She was happy when I picked her up, and you could tell she was treated with so much care and love.

They did such a beautiful job with her grooming, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience. So so glad we found our spa ❤️

I want to share a concerning experience at Animal Cracker. My eight-year-old Beagle, Penny, had resisted going inside on several recent visits. I thought it was because he dislikes baths, and I feel terrible that I didn’t take his reaction more seriously.

On our last visit, Julius , my boyfriend’s three-year-old Golden Retriever, walked toward the entrance, then pulled hard on his leash to get away when he saw the place. He is very friendly and had never reacted like that with me. Seeing both dogs refuse to enter, I took them home.

I don’t know what caused their reactions and am not accusing anyone, but we won’t be returning. I’m sharing this to encourage other pet parents to pay close attention to their dogs’ behavior.
Amazing experience. My dog loved it

We live in Miami Beach and happily make the drive to this groomer because he is truly the best! We have two big Golden Retrievers, and one of them really does not like the blower. Instead of rushing her or giving up, he took the time to figure out what worked for her—low and slow. He is the first groomer who has ever been able to get her completely blown out and comfortable with the process. That alone is worth the drive from Miami Beach!

The owner and entire staff are always so friendly, patient, and accommodating. You can tell they genuinely care about the dogs and take the time to understand each one individually. We are so happy we found them and wouldn’t take our girls anywhere else!
be careful of this place they left this inside my dog’s ear he was scratching himself for 24 hours until i found out. STAY AWAY

Amazing place for all your pet needs!
The owner is very welcoming and attentive!

ZERO STARS. Animal Crackers and the incompetent owner should be ashamed of how my dog was treated.

I trusted this business with my dog’s safety and somehow that ended with my dog IN THE HOSPITAL.

That is not a small mistake. That is not an “oops.” That is a complete failure of the most basic responsibility an animal care business has.

In my experience, the level of incompetence, carelessness, and lack of accountability from the owner was absolutely disgusting. You are literally being paid to keep animals SAFE. If you cannot handle that responsibility, you have no business taking people’s money and taking custody of their pets.

My dog walked into your care trusting the humans around him and I ended up dealing with a medical emergency. I cannot even describe the anger of handing someone a healthy animal and then having to rush that animal to the hospital because of what happened under their watch.

And what makes it even worse is the complete lack of accountability afterward.

No pet owner should ever have to wonder whether their dog is safe after dropping them off somewhere that claims to care about animals.

This experience was horrifying.

Animal Crackers completely destroyed my trust. I would not leave a stuffed animal in their care after what happened to my dog.

If you love your pet, ASK QUESTIONS before leaving them here. Ask exactly who is supervising the animals. Ask what happens during an emergency. Ask how they prevent injuries. Ask who is actually responsible when something goes wrong.

Because when something went horribly wrong with MY dog, I was the one left dealing with the hospital, the fear, the stress, the bills, and the consequences.

My dog cannot write this review, so I am writing it for him.

He deserved better.

I will NEVER bring my dog back to Animal Crackers, and based on my experience, I would never recommend this place to anyone who actually cares about the safety of their animal.

Absolutely unacceptable.

I have enjoyed scootering over to this downtown family-run gem for years. And I come over from Brickell. I do so because they have the food my dogs want, grooming & nail trimming prices are reasonable,  and JJ is just a great character. (If you are uptight by nature you may misunderstand his humor!) ;) I can only hope the evil developers of Miami don't take over the building at some point. But I could see JJ standing out front fighting them off! ;)
It was my first time at this place, and my little dog came out super happy and cute They took the time to explain everything to us, which really put me at ease.highly recommended.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Absolute lifesaver for nervous dog parents!

I moved to Miami almost a year ago and have been terrified to take my dog to a groomer after several bad experiences elsewhere (where she’d come back traumatized, sad, or looking like a rat). I’d been grooming her myself out of fear, but as a newer dog mom, I finally decided to give Animal Crackers a try—and I am SO grateful I did!

JJ was incredible from start to finish. I’m definitely an overprotective, anxious dog mom, and I don't know any of the technical grooming terms or blade types. JJ listened patiently, completely understood my vision, and handled both me and my dog with so much care and patience.

A few highlights that blew me away:
Total Price Transparency: Pricing was super clear upfront ($85 for the full package including bath, haircut, and trim)—exactly what was listed on their website.

Honesty & Kindness: My dog is prone to matting, and JJ was completely transparent after the groom. He explained the matting issue clearly and noted that extra brushing might cost $30–$40 in the future, but generously waived it for our first visit since I was new. That level of customer service is so rare!

Happy Dog! When I picked her up, she was so happy, relaxed, and looked adorable—a total 180 from past groomers where she was kept in cages and looked miserable.

10/10 communication and service. I honestly don't understand any of the negative reviews online—our experience was flawless. Huge sigh of relief for this dog mom! Thank you, JJ and the Animal Crackers team. You’ve made permanent customers out of us!

The owner is full on hands-on. It’s a Fantastic store for anything healthy for your Dog.  They are extremely accommodating, very helpful and for the first time ever, I just got my dog groomed there. They did a wonderful job and I’m picky as hell 🤷‍♀️ …

Such a great pet store! The only place I’ll bring my dog in for grooming. They take great care of him and he always looks perfect! The staff is friendly, and the store has a great selection of healthy, quality food & treats!
Our favorite Perruquería for Tula. JJ is on top of things and I cannot recommend this place enough.

I have been a loyal customer of this grooming shop for years and have always brought my two dogs here without issues. The price has always been $170. That suddenly changed today, without any explanation, when the owner tried to charge me $60 more for the exact same service.
When I questioned the unexpected increase, instead of explaining professionally, the owner screamed at me.

Completely unprofessional, disrespectful, and shocking behavior… Especially toward a long‑time customer. There was no courtesy, no discussion, just yelling and hostility.
If prices are going to change, that’s fine but springing it on a loyal client and then responding with aggression is unacceptable. Customer service clearly means nothing here anymore.
After this experience,

I will never return, and I strongly advise others to think twice before bringing their pets to a place where customers are treated this way.
I live right across the street, and my poodle absolutely loves coming here—for the treats, the food, and the love. The owner and staff are truly wonderful!

It’s important to give flowers to your community and this is my bouquet to animal crackers:
To have community care for our loving pets optimal, holistic care with vitamins, food, toys. I visit animal crackers once a month for all of my pets needs. It’s a 30 minute drive from my house and I refuse to go anywhere else or order on online and it can be delivered but then I miss the opportunity to interact with the beautiful team of animal crackers and all the friends that come for their spa treatment. The city needs more animal crackers thank you for what you do!
The only place I will ever take my Bernese Mountain Dog, Coco, to be groomed. They do an amazing job every time. So lucky to have them nearby.

My dog absolutely hates baths, and I’ve taken him twice so far to Animal Crackers and they are truly the best! They’re so patient with him and make sure he’s comfortable during the process. You can tell they genuinely care about your pets, which is hard to find these days. My dog always leaves happy and SO clean. Highly recommend!

Great place and highly recommend. They always do an excellent job grooming my dog, and you can tell they genuinely care about the animals. The staff is friendly, professional, and very attentive. The best sign of all is that my dog actually gets excited to go there, which says everything about how well they treat the dogs. Consistently great service and quality work every time. We wouldn’t go anywhere else.

I've been taking my dog Kevin, for over 5 years now. He's a rescue, and is notttt the easiest to deal with. I'm almost certain he's bitten the staff here once or twice. But even still, they welcome him back with open arms and are always so patient with him. Most times, I can't even get him out of my car, but JJ always steps in and Kevin seems to listen to him more than me, lol. This place is always super accommodating with my busy schedule, and they do a GREAT job with his cut and grooming. They're also fairly priced for the service they provide. 10 out of 10 for this place.
My pup loves going here to get groomed. All the staff are very friendly. The prices are reasonable and I appreciate that they don’t keep my girl longer than necessary as other groomers do.
AWESOME!!! I love how they treat my dog Drako
JJ and the team always take great care of my boys grooming and nails. The food is top quality and he recently recommended an anti-itch shampoo that has worked wonderfully. Always a great experience 💪

I was looking for a pet grooming place after moving from New Jersey, and I’m so glad I found this one! My Pomeranian’s fur is incredibly soft and she smells amazing — I seriously can’t get enough of her now 😍 The price is great too. Highly recommend! …
Friendly staff and they did a great job grooming my mini goldendoodle!! Def will go back!
Great pet store in the heart of downtown Miami.  Super friendly and helpful staff!

This place is the best in Miami for you pet, food, advice, grooming and toys/products, the staff is great as well. They worry about sustainability as well and I like that.
I know the owner since before the store opened and he delivered the best food for Archie to our door! Friendly, knowledgeable and no nonsense! Love this guy and the place!
AMAZING PLACE! I have been taking my dogs here for the last 8 years. I cannot say enough great things about the staff and the great work that they do at Animal Crackers.
Very happy with service,  fast and affordable 👌  A+
Excellent! They do a great job with my little Shih Tzu keeping her beautiful and free of knots!
Friendly affordable and my dogs come back happy.The most important part they have a smile on their face.When I pick them up
great staff, great pricing, grooming is always perfect

I can’t say enough wonderful things about JJ and the entire Animal Crackers staff! They go above and beyond every single time to take care of our Aussies — not only do they come home looking and smelling amazing after their grooms, but I know they’re treated with so much love and care throughout the day.

What really sets them apart is how thoughtful and dependable they are — they’ve even delivered food to our home when we were in a pinch! It’s rare to find someone who treats your pets (and your family) like their own. We’re so grateful to have found such a caring and trustworthy groomer. Highly, highly recommend! 🐾
THEY CUT THE DOGS SKIN!! Horrific
This place has it all... grooming, clothing (dogs n cats) and in between. Treats, RAw dog food, cooked... great place in the heart of downtown Miami.. and FREE DELIVERY.

I just became a return customer! Love this place. My pups groom is literally perfect. They made recommendations based on their knowledge and they were right! The staff is so personable and down to earth. Pricing is great. Overall wonderful experience. See you guys next time!
Good place, bad service at all
I was so nervous trying a new groomer for my two dogs. (We are new to the area) but they did an AMAZING job and were so kind and welcoming!! Couldn’t be happier. They have a forever customer!
Really knowledgeable and friendly staff. Owner is passionate about animal wellness and grooming services. Tons of quality food and supplements for dogs & cats. Cute store in downtown -shop local!

This place has everything for your pets! The grooming is exceptional, took care of my English bulldog and Frenchie and they look amazing! JJ is the man and a Miami legend🙏🏼 You definitely need to come check this place out!! …

I took my dog ​​for a bath, and unfortunately, it wasn't a good experience. She came out with watery and irritated eyes, which worried me a lot because she'd never had anything like that happen before. I think it's important that they be more careful with the products they use and how they handle pets. They didn't give me an explanation or notice anything wrong, which leaves me with doubts about how she was treated.

I hope they improve these details because the health and well-being of our pets should be a priority.

Best dog groomer in the area. My dog Kobe can be very picky with groomers and he loves going to animal crackers. They also carry the best pet products and are very knowledgeable about the best thing for your pet. Highly recommend! Can't wait to come back!
Worse service and if that’s to people I can’t imagine how they will treat animals in there

Animal Crackers is a Miami treasure, for dog lovers! They provide exceptional care in grooming even the most fragile dog... taking a matted mess to pure silken beauty.
Do not hesitate to make Animal Crackers your go-to establishment for grooming, quality food, and every accessory and toy you could need.
They care. They are careful, and gentle. They will soon be referred to as ypur friends!
The best for frenchies!! Mini loves it here :)
Did a great job grooming my son's dog.

I have been taking my rescue since 2022, he is not the easiest to handle and he comes back perfect every time. I would recommend this place to anyoneeee also I only can find my dogs food here or online - they carry quality products
Best prices and they offer delivery.
My dog smells amazing for days. Love them
Love ❤️

After 2 horrible groomings with a different groomer, I was so scared to get my puppy groomed again. Animal Crackers exceeded expectations, my baby boy looks amazing and came out smiling!! The most perfect grooming ever. I’m so glad I finally found a groomer I can trust! 11/10 recommend!
All I know is my dogs are super happy to be there and they’re clean when I pick them up. The fact that this small business has survived in downtown miami for as long as it has speaks for itself!
As soon as I walked up, I knew this place was legit. The staff are all animal lovers and it shows , my Dogs bath was great ! 10 out of 10. Highly recommend.
They are excellent, my dog ​​always comes out very happy from there and they are the best at detangling his hair.

This business warrants ZERO STARS. My dog's food was not delivered to my door as promised but rather dumped under the lobby front desk (see photo), leaving it exposed and vulnerable to theft. This unacceptable delivery practice, compounded by their website's lack of clear delivery policy information, ignited a serious dispute with my building manager, who held me responsible for the mishandled delivery.
I contacted the business owner to address the problem and respectfully inform him I would no longer be a customer; his response was appalling. Instead of offering a simple apology or attempting to rectify the situation, he resorted to shouting and stating that 'free delivery' justified his decision not to deliver to my door.
Regrettably, this isn't an isolated incident. Due to my cancer, I'm physically unable to transport the dog food from the lobby to my apartment. I mentioned my health condition to the owner when this happened in the past, and he never advised me that he wouldn't deliver to my door. I have had times delivered to my door. Does it depend on his mood?
Lastly, and in a desperate attempt to deflect blame, he absurdly claimed his delivery person waited 20 minutes for the front desk staff when a simple elevator ride would have delivered the food to my door in a fraction of that time.
The owner's complete disregard, lack of empathy, shouting, and poor customer service, culminating in him hanging up on me, is a testament to his blatant incompetence and carelessness for customers.
Zero stars are far too generous.

🙏I had a wonderful experience with this groomer! My Maltese is not very friendly, but they handled her with so much care and patience. She came out looking absolutely beautiful with a perfectly clean and fluffy coat. I really appreciate their professionalism and kindness. Highly recommend!
Thank you you guys 🌺☀️
Great range of products, fantastic customer service!

I love this place and the owner has the best personality always. I took my little miniature schnauzer Moxie there for her first grooming, and it’s probably the best cut I’ve ever seen on her. Adorable! 😍 …
My Dogs (Simon and Nala) Love Animal Crackers… I really appreciate all the staff because they are friendly and respectful with us…

I can’t believe I was still taking my dogs to this place. Every time I bring them they shake like crazy, I thought they just didn’t like being groomed. This time, I decided to come check the reviews (the friend who recommended this place also stopped using it for a bad experience I hope he shares here). After seeing the reviews about the treatment to the dogs AND the business owner to employees and customers, as well as the odd pricing, I asked about the price for grooming each of my dogs. The owner was charging $10 extra, which I asked about (I would always just pay and not inquire about the price given). This man got so mad after I just pointed to the prices listed on the wall. I just asked what was the reason, and he said “because I determined so”, I ask “what made you “determine” that?”, he continued to say “because I say so”, literally screaming to me, furious, extremely disrespectfully.
I can’t wait to see his response to this review, as it seems he always changes the story when replying to the bad reviews people have left about him. Really curious to see what he comes up with about my experience today, such a joke.

I can’t imagine how much money he’s taken from me because “he determined so”, and I can’t believe I ignored my dogs’ signs. I was in another city for three months and the dog I took with me would even get excited to see the guy who groomed her. I feel so upset just thinking about the treatment they must have received there all this time, not mentioning how much time my dogs have had to stay there on a scheduled grooming. It’s been times where it’s been +4 hrs after their appointment time for them to be ready (2 small dogs).

Funny enough, the girl they currently have as a receptionist (which always changes, no wonder why..) was also rude and I walked to the store to her, rolling her eyes while on a call that seemed to be a regular scheduling.

Beware and save yourself such a bad experience.

Bruce went to Animal Crackers for the first time today as a puppy, and they did an incredible job! He was nervous, but the staff said he was playing with the other dogs and didn’t have a care! The staff was outstanding and very professional. We will definitely be making this our place!
Best pet store in Miami!

We’ve been customers of this place for about a year. Our dog goes there happily and leaves happily. However, we have the same experience every single time we have our dog groomed.

We give them specific instructions to cut our dog’s body, paws, and head. We even show pictures. Yet, every single time, they ignore these instructions, barely cut our dog’s hair, give her a bath and a blow-dry, and charge us between $200 and $250. Today was no different. We also told the person who brought our dog back that they hadn’t cut her hair short enough. The only reaction we got was that she barely acknowledged our concern and told us she was not the groomer.

I understand that it might make sense for them to avoid cutting too much of my dog’s hair so that we return sooner and they can charge us again. However, this is neither ethical nor a good business practice, as we will be looking for another groomer at this point.

I recently took my dog to Animal Crackers for grooming, and I couldn’t be happier with the experience! The staff was incredibly friendly and professional, and they took great care of my dog. The attention to detail and genuine care they …
Love 😍 …
